name: Atlantoaxial Instability
definition: Excessive pathological motion between atlas and axis, congenital, inflammatory, traumatic or degenerative in origin, with potential cord compromise.

investigations.principle: MRI assesses cord compression; CT/dynamic studies are selected by specialists according to stability concern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Treatment ranges from observation to fusion depending on risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva/Sandhi instability phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Excessive pathological motion between atlas and axis, congenital, inflammatory, traumatic or degenerative in origin, with potential cord compromise.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
